_comment: Copy to <stateDir>/tokenomics/subscriptions.json and edit to your plans. Each plan declares rolling windows (name, hours, unit: tokens|requests|messages, cap). Usage is measured from the local ledger; the ?view=quota route reports used/cap, when each window next frees, and an 'approaching' flag at >=80%. Caps below are ILLUSTRATIVE — set them to your actual subscription limits. There is no universal provider API for live plan quota (Anthropic/OpenAI expose rate-limit response headers + Admin-key usage APIs; MiniMax's Token Plan is dashboard-only with 5h+weekly windows), so config + ledger is the portable source of truth.
